sentence: This project studies the role of a growth factor receptor in blood vessel cells and immune cells during wound healing.
This project designs a treatment that tries to help people at risk for HIV start taking and keep taking a drug that prevents infection.
This project uses deep learning to analyze eye scans so that diseases of the optic nerve can be found earlier and tracked over time.
This project tries to find out how proteins that help build a temporary matrix guide repair of the injured lung.
This project builds a method that finds the mutations behind cancer mutation signatures in normal human tissue samples.
This project tries to find out how epigenetic regulators cause T cells to become exhausted and stop fighting tumors.
This project studies how fasting and refeeding change intestinal stem cells, which repair the gut but can also start tumors.
This project uses wearable devices to measure how close mothers and their partners stay to each other and how that relates to depression symptoms.
This project tries to find out how membrane proteins break down lipids and make lipid products that are involved in immune responses.
This project uses computer modeling of behavioral and environmental data to improve how mental health problems in children are identified and predicted.
This project runs a tissue bank that collects and stores tumor samples and gives cancer researchers access to them.
This project studies the immune changes that happen during peanut desensitization therapies, to find out how they work in patients.
This project supports research on intellectual and developmental disabilities by providing shared resources and equipment to researchers.
This project uses computer and math models to understand how complex biological systems work.
This project builds a small device that uses a simple blood sample to measure signs of Alzheimer's disease.
This project uses human organoid models to study how influenza and SARS-CoV-2 vaccination and infection affect the immune system.
This project gets a gel imager to study how pesticides change protein levels in nerve cells and proteins related to heart health and aging.
This project builds tools and computer pipelines to map and study specific cell types in the marmoset brain.
This project studies how connective tissue cells and immune cells affect each other during infection and tissue damage.
